**sdd/issue-887-lane-collector/tasks**

**What**: Wrote `openspec/changes/issue-887-lane-collector/tasks.md` — STRICT TDD task breakdown for the #887 lane collector, following the design's two-slice split: Slice A (planner — `lane/plan.mjs`, `lane/plan.test.mjs`, A7's `canonicalOrNull` move from `store.mjs` to `format.mjs`, ~152 counted) and Slice B (shell + verb — `lane/collect.mjs`, `collect` op in `memory/cli.mjs`, i18n en/es, `package.json`, `collect.integration.test.mjs`, `cli.collect.test.mjs`, ~242 counted). Each red/green pair maps to spec.md's STRICT TDD test map cases.
**Why**: `sdd-tasks` phase for issue-887-lane-collector, delivery_strategy=ask-on-risk, chain_strategy left PENDING per the orchestrator's instruction because the design's "stacked-to-main" recommendation conflicts with governance gates when both PRs target the same issue.
**Where**: `openspec/changes/issue-887-lane-collector/tasks.md` (new). Evidence read from `brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs:234-267` (`requiresClosingKeyword`, `extractIssueNumber`) and `brain/scripts/governance/checks/issue-ref-patterns.mjs:30,35` (`CLOSING_RE`, `CHAIN_RE`).
**Learned**: `requiresClosingKeyword(ctx)` returns `ctx.targetBranch === ctx.defaultBranch`. When true (any PR targeting `main`), `extractIssueNumber` matches ONLY `CLOSING_RE` — it never falls through to `CHAIN_RE` ("Part of #N"). So a PR to `main` carrying only "Part of #887" is REFUSED by `issue-link`. This breaks the epic's literal "stacked-to-main, no tracker branch" rule (`archive/862/design.md:240-241`) when applied to an in-issue split (two PRs closing the SAME issue #887), because that rule was written for epic-task-level slices (#887/#888/#889/#890 are different issues, each with its own closing PR). Three viable shapes documented in tasks.md: (1) both PRs target main and both close #887 — gate-legal but causes GitHub to prematurely auto-close #887 when PR A merges, before the collector is actually invocable (Slice B); NOT recommended. (2) feature-branch chain — PR A targets a non-default branch so `requiresClosingKeyword` is false and "Part of #887"/"Parent: #864" is accepted; PR B targets main and carries "Closes #887" — RECOMMENDED, closes the issue only when the verb exists. (3) single PR with `size:exception` (only honored at `lite`/`standard` tiers per `tierParams(tier).honorSizeException`, `run-check.mjs:399-438`) — sidesteps the issue-link question entirely. Decision left pending for the orchestrator/maintainer; tasks.md plans for the split shape but includes a "Single-PR fallback" section for shape 3.
